description: 3-stage TOCTOU race condition in account creation: (1) implement account CRUD handlers with synchronous validation that blocks until complete, (2) add uniqueness validation — reject accounts with duplicate names, (3) move account validation to background goroutine for faster API response — validation sets validated=true after slow work in goroutine, but AddAccount returns immediately with validated=false. Concurrent account creations with the same name all pass the uniqueness check (account not yet validated) and each spawns its own goroutine, resulting in duplicate validated accounts.
